rationale: The runtime routingAnalytics flag is added, RoutingAnalyticsSection is conditionally rendered, and enabled and disabled behavior is covered by focused tests. No unresolved findings remain.

business_review.criterion: Routing analytics is hidden when features:routingAnalytics is disabled
business_review.notes: InsightsTab regression test confirms the section is absent when the flag is disabled.

business_review.criterion: Routing analytics remains available when the flag is enabled
business_review.notes: InsightsTab regression test confirms the section is rendered when the flag is enabled.

standards_review.notes: Uses the existing runtime feature-flag hook and shared FEATURE_FLAGS constant.
Focused unit tests pass for both flag states.
